# Managed file

Files osapi writes on a host and keeps a record of.
`osapi behavior get --name managedfile` and `osapi behavior method get` show the
same.

## Method get

|             |                                        |
| ----------- | -------------------------------------- |
| Name        | get                                    |
| Verb        | read                                   |
| Description | Read the record of a file osapi wrote  |
| Route       | other behaviors only; it is not served |
| Input type  | GetInput                               |
| Output type | Record                                 |

### Input (1)

| FIELD | TYPE   | REQUIRED | CONSTRAINTS | DESCRIPTION               |
| ----- | ------ | -------- | ----------- | ------------------------- |
| path  | string | yes      | pattern ^/  | Absolute path of the file |

### Output (5)

| FIELD         | TYPE    | DESCRIPTION                                                                                           |
| ------------- | ------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| path          | string  | Absolute path of the file                                                                             |
| sha256        | string  | Checksum of the content osapi wrote                                                                   |
| metadata      | object  | What the caller keeps in the record                                                                   |
| undeployed    | boolean | Whether osapi has stopped managing the file                                                           |
| object_sha256 | string  | SHA-256 of the object that the content came from, in hex; empty for a secret or a file from no object |

### Examples (2)

| EXAMPLE                       | INPUT                        | OUTPUT                                                                                                                                             |
| ----------------------------- | ---------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| A file osapi wrote            | path=/etc/osapi/example.conf | path=/etc/osapi/example.conf, sha256=b6ac5bc39377e44ee783dff946f6703a994f5eb31a438e69dc0735b40060d2e8, metadata=map\[setting:on], undeployed=false |
| A file osapi stopped managing | path=/etc/osapi/example.conf | path=/etc/osapi/example.conf, sha256=b6ac5bc39377e44ee783dff946f6703a994f5eb31a438e69dc0735b40060d2e8, metadata=map\[setting:on], undeployed=true  |

## Method update

|             |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| ----------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| Name        | update                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| Verb        | write                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| Description | Write a file and keep a record of it                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| Detail      | Leaves a file already holding the content alone and reports changed: false when its record has the same metadata and object. A file edited by hand is put back. New metadata, or a new object or object checksum, changes only the record. |
| Route       | other behaviors only; it is not served                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| Input type  | UpdateInput                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| Output type | Result                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |

### Input (10)

| FIELD         | TYPE    | REQUIRED | CONSTRAINTS                       | DESCRIPTION                                                                                    |
| ------------- | ------- | -------- | --------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| path          | string  | yes      | pattern ^/                        | Absolute path of the file                                                                      |
| content       | string  | yes      |                                   | The file's whole content                                                                       |
| mode          | string  | no       | pattern ^\[0-7]&#123;3,4&#125;$   | Permissions in octal, such as 0600; when empty, a file keeps its mode and a new file gets 0644 |
| owner         | string  | no       | pattern ^\[a-z_]\[a-z0-9_-]\*\$?$ | User that owns the file; left as written when empty                                            |
| group         | string  | no       | pattern ^\[a-z_]\[a-z0-9_-]\*\$?$ | Group that owns the file; left as written when empty                                           |
| secret        | boolean | no       |                                   | The content is a secret: its record keeps no checksum of it                                    |
| metadata      | object  | no       |                                   | What the caller keeps in the file's record, such as the setting it holds                       |
| object        | string  | no       |                                   | The object of the object store that the content came from; empty when it came from no object   |
| content_type  | string  | no       | one of raw template               | How the content was made from its object: raw or template                                      |
| object_sha256 | string  | no       |                                   | SHA-256 of the object that the content came from, in hex                                       |

### Output (2)

| FIELD   | TYPE    | DESCRIPTION               |
| ------- | ------- | ------------------------- |
| path    | string  | Absolute path of the file |
| changed | boolean | Whether the host changed  |

### Examples (5)

| EXAMPLE                               | INPUT                                                                                                                                                 | OUTPUT                                     |
| ------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------ |
| A new file                            | path=/etc/osapi/example.conf, content=on , mode=, owner=, group=, secret=false, metadata=&lt;nil&gt;, object=, content_type=, object_sha256=          | path=/etc/osapi/example.conf, changed=true |
| A secret only root reads              | path=/etc/myapp/token, content=s3cret , mode=0600, owner=root, group=root, secret=true, metadata=&lt;nil&gt;, object=, content_type=, object_sha256=  | path=/etc/myapp/token, changed=true        |
| A secret only root reads, on a Mac    | path=/etc/myapp/token, content=s3cret , mode=0600, owner=root, group=wheel, secret=true, metadata=&lt;nil&gt;, object=, content_type=, object_sha256= | path=/etc/myapp/token, changed=true        |
| A file whose mode was changed by hand | path=/etc/osapi/example.conf, content=on , mode=0600, owner=, group=, secret=false, metadata=&lt;nil&gt;, object=, content_type=, object_sha256=      | path=/etc/osapi/example.conf, changed=true |
| A file edited by hand                 | path=/etc/osapi/example.conf, content=on , mode=, owner=, group=, secret=false, metadata=&lt;nil&gt;, object=, content_type=, object_sha256=          | path=/etc/osapi/example.conf, changed=true |

## Method delete

|             |                                                                                        |
| ----------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Name        | delete                                                                                 |
| Verb        | write                                                                                  |
| Description | Remove a file osapi wrote and stop managing it                                         |
| Detail      | Leaves a file osapi has no record of alone, so it never removes what it did not write. |
| Route       | other behaviors only; it is not served                                                 |
| Input type  | DeleteInput                                                                            |
| Output type | Result                                                                                 |

### Input (1)

| FIELD | TYPE   | REQUIRED | CONSTRAINTS | DESCRIPTION               |
| ----- | ------ | -------- | ----------- | ------------------------- |
| path  | string | yes      | pattern ^/  | Absolute path of the file |

### Output (2)

| FIELD   | TYPE    | DESCRIPTION               |
| ------- | ------- | ------------------------- |
| path    | string  | Absolute path of the file |
| changed | boolean | Whether the host changed  |

### Examples (2)

| EXAMPLE                  | INPUT                        | OUTPUT                                      |
| ------------------------ | ---------------------------- | ------------------------------------------- |
| A file osapi wrote       | path=/etc/osapi/example.conf | path=/etc/osapi/example.conf, changed=true  |
| A file osapi never wrote | path=/etc/osapi/example.conf | path=/etc/osapi/example.conf, changed=false |
